message.content:
As of the most recent information available to me (up to the end of 2023), the Vice President of the United States is **Kamala Harris**. She has been serving in that role since January 20, 2021.  

If you’re looking for the Vice President in 2026, that would depend on the outcome of the 2024 presidential election and any subsequent appointments. If the Biden‑Harris ticket was re‑elected, Kamala Harris would still be Vice President. If a different administration took office, the Vice President would be the running‑mate of the new President.
